rules.rule_context:
Compliance Note - Marketing Use of PHI

Under HIPAA and Meridian policy, protected health information may not be used or disclosed for marketing without a valid authorization that meets 45 CFR 164.508. "Marketing" includes any communication about a product or service that encourages recipients to purchase or use it, which covers wellness-program upsells.

Scope:
- In scope for marketing use without additional authorization: only records where a signed, HIPAA-compliant marketing consent is on file and current.
- Out of scope: any cohort derived from clinical encounters, discharge diagnoses, procedure codes, or scheduling queues unless every record in that cohort carries a verified marketing authorization.
- De-identified data sets that meet the Safe Harbor standard (no direct identifiers, no dates more specific than year, geographic unit no smaller than first three ZIP digits) are not PHI and fall outside this restriction.

Operational test: before releasing a contact list for a campaign, confirm that each record either (a) has a documented marketing authorization or (b) belongs to a fully de-identified aggregate. Lists that mix authorized and unauthorized records must be split; the unauthorized portion may not be released for marketing purposes.
